title: a list of deprecated tutorials

sections.heading: Deprecated Tutorials
sections.text:
This is list of deprecated tutorials. These may have used older versions of Amber or methods that are no longer commonly employed. Some tutorials are here because there are newer versions in process and/or too many updates are required to make the current version useful for new users.
As new tutorials are made, they will be populated on
the main Tutorials page
and current ones deprecated. However, they are still cataloged in the main Amber tutorials library and available upon request.
